fields.label: Mail service
fields.description: Gmail — SMTP/IMAP servers and ports are filled in automatically; you only need the email and an app password. Choose «Other» to enter the settings manually.

fields.label: Email address
fields.description: Full email address. For Gmail it is also used as the SMTP login.

fields.label: Open the Google app passwords page
fields.description:
To send email through Gmail you need an «app password», not the regular account password.

1. Open your Google account → «Security» and turn on «2-Step Verification» (app passwords are unavailable without it).
2. Click the button above or open https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords
3. Enter an app name (e.g. «Grunt») and click «Create».
4. Copy the 16-character code into the «SMTP password» field below — spaces can stay, they are removed automatically.

fields.label: SMTP user
fields.description: SMTP login. Usually the same as the email address; filled in automatically for Gmail.

fields.label: SMTP password (app password)
fields.description:
For Gmail — a 16-character app password (App Password). The regular Google account password does not work.
A saved password is not shown again — to change it, enter a new one.

fields.label: Test connection (SMTP)
fields.description: Checks the connection and sign-in to the SMTP server without sending an email.

fields.label: Send test email
fields.description: Sends a short test email to the given address through this account. Save your changes first.

fields.label: Enable outgoing mail
fields.description: Allows this account to send emails.

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.description: For Gmail: smtp.gmail.com — filled in automatically.

fields.label: Enable incoming mail
fields.description: Reads incoming emails over IMAP. Not needed just for sending. Gmail requires the same app password.
